response.overview: When Beldon takes over as foreman of Squaredeal’s ranch, a series of cattle thefts mysteriously comes to an end. His arrival also reignites a bitter rivalry with Cole, a former ranch manager whose mistreatment of a servant leads to a violent confrontation. Determined to settle the score, Cole plots revenge when Beldon is entrusted with a large sum of money to deposit at the bank. Accompanied by Squaredeal’s daughter, Beldon soon finds himself caught in a dangerous scheme that threatens both their lives.
response.title: Hearts o' the Range
